mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: In periods with FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, the S&P 500 has negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 4.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in higher rates.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in less than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS are both above their 3-month moving averages, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in less than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy support and economic recovery.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth above 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 200000, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) consistently signals strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above its 5-year average, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a slow-growth regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.5%), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in potential policy stimulus.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 < 1.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%) and a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals a hawkish monetary policy that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in less than 60% of cases.
